name: cold-bignum-typed_read
what: bench/function/typed_read.cpp; the bignum branch of decode_value in a cold function, against its parent
method: three binaries built in one container (a, aa = a built again, b); six rounds, the order alternates a b aa then aa b a; each run as nobody with --benchmark_enable_random_interleaving=true, 9 repetitions of at least 0.1 s; estimator: the minimum of each arm over its 54 repetitions; noise: aa over a; byte check: no bytes written by the function
byte_check: no bytes written by the function
priority: nice 0 of the bench process (asked -10: nice: cannot set niceness: Permission denied), container limited to 3 of 4 cpus, not pinned
